sloka: सागरम् तु समासाद्य पुनर्नष्टम् मनो मम ।कथम् नाम समुद्रस्य दुष्पारस्य महाम्भसः ॥६-१-१७॥।।
transliteration: sāgaram tu samāsādya punarnaṣṭam mano mama ।katham nāma samudrasya duṣpārasya mahāmbhasaḥ ॥6-1-17॥।।

translations.english: "How will all the monkeys together be able to cross to the southern shore of the vast ocean? It is difficult to cross."
